title: Operation
description: Append-only op-log entry. Every mutation writes its state change and its operation row in one transaction — this is the audit log and what makes undo possible. Per docs/pragmatic_mvp.md §4.2, §4.3.

target.description: Stable reference to the affected object

before.description: Prior state, or null for creation

after.description: Resulting state, or null for deletion
